decision.reason: [ev-d308231cd8ab] describes an additive, opt-in feature: keystore passwords can now be set as literal values, mutually exclusive with `passwordSecretRef`. It names no schema paths, so the proposed `spec.keystores.jks` and `spec.keystores.pkcs12` paths are not supported by the evidence, and neither is the new literal-password field. The evidence also does not say that any existing configuration fails or behaves differently. So flagging every Certificate that uses a keystore looks broader than any exposed state. Deciding this needs the CRD schema diff for #6657, which would show the new field path and whether existing Certificates are affected.
